description: Generate your dunstan-handback block from the local git checkout of your pull request's branch, after your last push: headCommit is HEAD, filesChanged is HEAD's diff against its merge base with base. Give directory, the checkout's absolute path. To declare tests, give tests.from "ci" with command, workflow and job once CI has finished on your last push: the counts are read from the JUnit record CI published, as the gate reads it, with GITHUB_TOKEN. For a GitLab merge request (DRAFT GitLab profile), give tests.from "ci" with gitlabProject, mergeRequest, command and job instead (gitlabHost off gitlab.com, path for the JUnit file in the job's artifacts archive, workflow optional): the counts are read from the merge request's head pipeline at HEAD, as the gate reads them, with GITLAB_TOKEN only; do not mix repository, artifact or artifactPath into it. tests.from "local" declares a local JUnit file as a local run, which the gate reports unverifiable. Returns the first line (tests: declared, tests: not declared, or tests: none asked) and the notes, then the fence, byte for byte what `dunstan template` prints. When the first line is tests: not declared, the block has no tests: do not add counts yourself; do what the note says. Add your references and checks yourself. Reads git and, with tests.from "ci", GitHub (or GitLab) metadata and the JUnit artifact (or archive) for its counts; writes nothing.

base.description: The ref the pull request merges into, as dunstan template --base. Absent: the remote's default branch.

directory.description: The absolute path of the local git checkout of the pull request's branch. Git runs there.

tests.description: Which tests to declare. Absent: none, and the note says how.

oneOf.description: Read CI's counts at HEAD from the JUnit record CI published, as the gate reads it (dunstan template --tests-ci): on GitHub, a workflow run's artifact; on a GitLab merge request (gitlabProject and mergeRequest), its head pipeline's job archive.

artifact.description: GitHub: the artifact holding the JUnit file. Absent: dunstan-junit.

artifactPath.description: GitHub: the JUnit file in the artifact. Absent: junit.xml.

command.description: The command that ran the tests, as the block declares it.

gitlabHost.description: GitLab: the host name, such as gitlab.example.com. Absent: gitlab.com.

gitlabProject.description: GitLab (DRAFT profile): the project's full path, group/subgroup/.../project, with mergeRequest; read with GITLAB_TOKEN. Not with repository, artifact or artifactPath.

job.description: The name of the job that uploaded the JUnit artifact; on GitLab, the job in the head pipeline whose artifacts archive holds it.

mergeRequest.description: GitLab: the merge request's iid, the number after !. Its head pipeline at HEAD is read.

path.description: GitLab: the JUnit file in the job's artifacts archive. Absent: junit.xml.

repository.description: GitHub: the repository, owner/name, read with GITHUB_TOKEN. Absent: the one the origin remote names. Not with the GitLab members.

workflow.description: The workflow file that ran them, as a path: .github/workflows/ci.yml. Required on GitHub. On GitLab, the project's CI configuration file; absent, the one the project names (ci_config_path, else .gitlab-ci.yml).

oneOf.description: Declare a local JUnit file as a local run, which the gate reports unverifiable (dunstan template --tests-local).

command.description: The command that ran the tests, as the block declares it.

junit.description: The local JUnit XML file; a relative path resolves against directory.

name: dunstan_template_handback
title: Generate a handback block from git
